transaction.description: chunked (default) commits 2,000-row chunks and skips bad rows; all_or_nothing is one transaction that rolls back on the first error.

post.description: Send the bytes as the raw request body with an X-File-Name header (percent-encode non-ASCII names), or as multipart/form-data with the file in a field named file. The file is stored once per content (SHA-256) and returned as `pending`; it becomes `attached` when a row's attachments field refers to its id, and a pending file nothing refers to within 24 hours is deleted. The content type is detected from the bytes; a type sent by the client is ignored.
